title: sisymbrium polymorphum
intro: Sisymbrium polymorphum, commonly known as Polymorphum or Desert Marigold, is a perennial herb in the family Brassicaceae. It is native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and Mexico, and its bright yellow flowers bloom during the spring season. The health benefits of Sisymbrium polymorphum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
